firmware.title: PK-01 Lvov
firmware.author: DnCraptor; Emu80 by V. Pykhonin
firmware.description: The Soviet PK-01 Lvov, an 8080 home computer with colour graphics, on Emu80. Loads tape images from the SD card.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard. Alt: menu, Enter: select, Esc: back, Ctrl+Alt+Del: reset.
